description: Automatic merge-conflict resolution lets an agent edit files in the BASE working tree — the one irreversible Brain decision in the system. No deterministic tier may authorise it, even though the request carries a recommended option: 'review' is recommended precisely because it is the safe side, and a free tier that started picking recommended options at critical risk would eventually pick the destructive one elsewhere.

request.question: Should Goal try to resolve merge conflicts for phase "api-surface" automatically?
request.context:
Phase id: phase-4
Conflicted files: src/router.ts, src/types.ts
Base working tree: /repo

options.label: Try the configured conflict resolver
options.consequence: A resolver agent may edit conflicted files in the base working tree.

options.label: Keep the worktree for human review
options.consequence: No automatic conflict resolution is attempted.
